title: A planning practice set finds why traps are missed; fixes for new entities, two dates and a named outcome
request: The planning exam hp_gate_v2 failed and its rows may not be read. The owner asked for a practice set to find why, then chose fixes 1 (entity split for new entities), 2 (two dates) and 4 (named outcome).
spec: Practice cases written by a session that never read the planner; the exam's builder unchanged (its hash is pinned); rules arm only, no model; every fix makes the evaluation stricter or asks; rules in dclab_core, wiring in dclab_rnd.
plan: a free runner that explains each planted trap

decisions.decision: Entity split only when the brief says new entities
decisions.why: for the same customers again a time split with the customer on both sides is the honest test (the end-to-end future set lesson)

decisions.decision: Ask, never apply, an entity split the engine cannot make beside time
decisions.why: applying it failed every such build: a failed build is worse than an open question

decisions.decision: Never guess the entity when the brief's noun names no column
decisions.why: the review showed a customer split chosen for 'the stores we open'

decisions.decision: Fix 3 (leaks found by data, not name) left out
decisions.why: testing every column for too-good would drop honest strong columns like last week's footfall

change: dclab_core/split_hints.py (new, 0.163.0), dclab_rnd/tasks/catalog.py (entity_key from the brief and the data), dclab_rnd/tasks/enforced.py (can_group), dclab_rnd/tasks/path.py (group_fits), dclab_rnd/tasks/dispatch.py (the same guard), dclab_rnd/expansion/datasets.py (time_group_feasible reads the folds), dclab_rnd/intern/loop.py (first-known date, its note), dclab_rnd/studio/data.py (predict X breaks a tie); practice set and runner; tests/test_split_hints.py, tests/test_planning_practice.py.

findings.defect: The rules plan never kept new entities apart.
findings.cause: an entity key came only from a declared fact or a joined table's _id key
findings.fix: entity_key from the brief's new-entity words and the main table

findings.defect: Two date columns gave a random split with no question.
findings.scenario: booking_date and appt_date; ts and due_date; booking_date and arrival_date: 6 of 6 time misses.
findings.cause: found_time_column returned None for two candidates
findings.fix: the date known first on 95% of rows in the same period orders the split, with a note

findings.defect: An outcome named in backticks was lost to an everyday word.
findings.scenario: 'still on the line ... Predict `defect`': line and defect matched, the build stopped on both seeds.
findings.cause: two column names in the words left the outcome unnamed
findings.fix: a column named right after predict, forecast or estimate breaks the tie

findings.defect: Leaks are found by name only.
findings.scenario: late_fee_charged, n_followups, days_to_resolve, rework_minutes: 8 of 16 missed, three in the final model.
findings.cause: leak evidence weighs only name-suspected columns

findings.defect: Applying the entity split beside a time split failed every build.
findings.scenario: pr05, pr08, pr09, pr12: 'With both ts and meter_id declared ... leaving 0 to test on'.
findings.cause: every entity appears in every period

findings.defect: The guard read only the holdout rule; the engine's fold rule then failed the build.
findings.scenario: 30 stores every week and 10 new ones in the last 4 weeks: guard yes, prepare_bundle fails on folds.
findings.fix: it reads the training folds too, on rows with an outcome and a readable time, with the project's fold count

findings.defect: The task-execution path applied the entity split with no guard.
findings.scenario: enforce_plan on a store-every-week project set time and group; the first stage failed.
findings.cause: the guard lived in path.py only
findings.fix: the guard is a callback of enforced.changes, passed by both paths

findings.defect: first_known_time raised on dates with and without a zone.
findings.scenario: created_at 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z beside due_date 2025-01-04: TypeError; before, a random split.
findings.fix: every column parsed with utc=True; any error returns None

findings.defect: A sign-up date could order the split instead of the row's snapshot date.
findings.scenario: signup 2018-2025 beside six months of snapshots: signup chosen; training holds later snapshots.
findings.cause: overlap was measured against the shorter span
findings.fix: overlap of at least half of the longer span

findings.defect: Briefs not about unseen entities were read as new entities.
findings.scenario: 'our New York stores', 'new stores are out of scope', 'we do not open new branches', 'additional fields', 'fraud on new accounts', 'unseen categories'.
findings.cause: the pattern ignored places, negations and kinds of rows
findings.fix: case, negation and kind-of-row checks; bare 'unseen' and 'fields' removed

findings.defect: The wrong entity could be chosen.
findings.scenario: 'stores we open' with no store column chose customer_id; num_items read as a key.
findings.cause: fallback to the finest key; num and number as key words
findings.fix: no column named by the noun: none; num, number removed; no only as the last word

findings.defect: A quoted name beat an outcome named in plain words.
findings.scenario: 'Predict churn next month. Note: `plan_type` was renamed' returned plan_type.
findings.fix: only a name after predict, forecast or estimate breaks a tie

findings.defect: The time note claimed a choice that was never made.
findings.scenario: order_date with a gappy birth_date: the note said birth_date comes later.
findings.cause: the note was written whenever other dates existed

measurements.name: Practice set v1, rules arm, 12 cases x 2 seeds, before and after the fixes
measurements.gate: none: a practice set read by the fixer
measurements.result: enforced 18 to 24 of 48; time 10 to 16 of 16; entity 0 to 0 applied, 2 asked; late 8 to 8; builds failed 0, wrong stops 2 to 0
measurements.next: a fresh held-out exam written by another session; an engine split for new entities in a later period
limits: the rules were written after reading this set

outcome: The planner now orders two-date tables by the first-known date and no longer loses a named outcome. An entity split for new entities is read from the brief and applied only when the engine can make it, else asked; on the practice tables it is asked.
lessons: A guard must copy every test of the code it protects, not the first one.
A rule meant to help must never guess: a wrong entity split is worse than none.
Read a planted trap against real use before calling it a miss.
risks: Fitted to a set the fixer read: unproven until a fresh exam.
New-entity words are a word list: other phrasings are missed.
needs_model_planning now routes some new-entity projects to the model planner when a model is configured.
